## Component and version

State whether this concerns the rebuild or `prototype/`. Include the branch or commit and relevant browser/runtime versions. For the prototype, say whether the backend was running or the page used demo mode.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest sequence of steps and sanitized test data needed to reproduce the problem.

## Expected and actual behavior

Explain what should happen and what happens instead.

## Evidence

Include relevant screenshots or error messages after removing credentials, tokens, personal data, private addresses, and environment-specific infrastructure details.

Report vulnerabilities privately using the repository's security policy.
